WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(region, 'Unknown') AS region_val
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'customers') }}
    WHERE is_active = 1
)
SELECT
    MIN(region_val) AS region,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM base
GROUP BY LOWER(RTRIM(region_val))

explanation: This procedure counts active customers in each region, using "Unknown" for customers with no region recorded. It replaces any previous version of the output table with the fresh counts each time it runs. The model below matches SQL Server's default case-insensitive, trailing-space-insensitive grouping, so regions that differ only in capitalization or trailing spaces are combined into one row.
